notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing
notices.agenda_text:
GRANTSVILLE CITY
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2027 BUDGET AMENDMENTS

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Grantsville City Council will hold a public hearing on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 7:00 p.m., or as soon thereafter as the matter may be heard, at the Council Chambers of Grantsville City Hall, located at 429 E. Main Street, Grantsville, Utah and electronically via Zoom, to receive public comment regarding proposed amendments to the City's Fiscal Year 2027 budget, covering July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027.

The public hearing will be conducted pursuant to Utah Code Sections 10-6-127, 10-6-113, and 10-6-114.

The proposed amendments include increased appropriations for general government professional services, dues and fees; library employee appreciation and grant expenditures; rodeo expenses; Building Department computer software; Community Development grant expenses; and Planning Commission stipends. The amendments also include reductions to Parks and Recreation and Cemetery salary appropriations, increases to Water and Sewer salary appropriations, a corresponding reduction to the Water capital water line project appropriation, and a reduction to the Sewer contribution to fund balance.

The proposed budget increases the amount budgeted for use of General Fund balance from $1,593,698 to $1,665,104, an increase of $71,406. The total Water and Sewer fund budgets remain unchanged, with adjustments to appropriations within those funds.

Copies of the proposed budget amendments will be available for public inspection before the hearing at Grantsville City Hall, located at 429 E. Main Street, Grantsville, Utah and on the City's website at www.grantsvilleut.gov.

All interested persons are invited to attend the public hearing and will be given an opportunity to speak for or against the proposed amendments, including any affected revenue or expenditure item. Written comments may also be submitted to the City Recorder at afairbourne@grantsvilleut.gov before the hearing. Written comments must be received prior to 12:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. 

Following the public hearing, the City Council may consider adoption of the proposed budget amendments.


Dated this 14th day of October, 2026.
Alicia Fairbourne
Grantsville City Recorder

notices.title: Notice of Ordinance Adoption
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ORDINANCE ADOPTION

PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Grantsville City Council adopted the following ordinances at its regular City Council meetings held on the dates identified below:

- Ordinance 2026-05, adopted August 19, 2026, approves the rezoning of property located at approximately 500 West Apple Street for the Apple Street Townhomes
Subdivision to RM-15 (Multiple Residential District), excluding approximately 1.19 acres retained for commercial use along the SR-138 frontage.

- Ordinance 2026-29, adopted September 16, 2026, amends Chapter 15 of the Grantsville Land Use and Management Code to allow Micro-Entrepreneurship as a conditional use in the R-1-8, R-1-12, R-1-21, RM-7, and RM-15 zoning districts, subject to existing standards, operating limitations, and separate application and approval requirements.

- Ordinance 2026-30, adopted September 16, 2026, amends Chapters 2, 6, and 7 of the Grantsville Land Use Ordinance to remove the minimum 100-foot frontage requirement for home occupation permit eligibility, remove the fixed 60-foot driveway separation requirement near intersections, and clarify referral of conditional use applications to the Planning Commission when public comments raise concerns.

- Ordinance 2026-28, adopted October 5, 2026, amends Chapter 9 of the Grantsville Land Use Ordinance to update landscaping, waterwise landscaping, turf, irrigation, park strip, parkway, and median standards, including requirements for landscape plans, installation, maintenance, and approved plant materials.

Complete copies of the adopted ordinances are available for review at the Grantsville City Recorder's office during regular business hours and online through the City's website at https://grantsville.municipalcodeonline.com/book?type=orddoc#name=2026 and the Utah Public Notice Website at https://www.utah.gov/pmn/sitemap/publicbody/1840.html.


Alicia Fairbourne
Grantsville City Recorder
Published and posted on October 8, 2026 in accordance with UCA § 10-3-711

notices.title: Alington Subdivision Open House - Possible Quorum of City Council Present
notices.agenda_text:
PUBLIC NOTICE

Alington Subdivision Open House
Possible Quorum of City Council Present

PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that an open house regarding the proposed Alington Subdivision will be held on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at Grantsville City Hall, 429 E Main Street, Grantsville, Utah.

The open house is intended to provide an opportunity for residents and the developer to discuss the proposed development. The open house is not a meeting of the Grantsville City Council and will not be conducted or led by the City Council.

Members of the City Council may attend the open house, and a quorum of the City Council may be present. No formal City Council meeting will be convened, and no action or decisions will be taken by the City Council during the open house.

The Grantsville City Council will convene its regularly scheduled meeting at 7:00 p.m. immediately following the open house. The Alington Subdivision is scheduled for consideration during the City Council meeting, at which time the City Council may discuss and take action on the matter in accordance with the posted City Council agenda.

Alicia Fairbourne
Grantsville City Recorder

Posted on September 1, 2026, in accordance with the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.

notices.agenda_text:
GRANTSVILLE CITY
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
FISCAL YEAR 2027 FINAL BUDGET


PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Grantsville City Council will hold a public hearing on Wednesday, August 19, 2026, during its regularly scheduled City Council meeting for the purpose of receiving public comment regarding the adoption of the Final Budget for Fiscal Year 2027.

The public hearing will be held at the Grantsville City Council Chambers, 429 East Main Street, Grantsville, Utah, beginning at 7:00 p.m. and electronically via Zoom. 

Public comments are welcome and may be provided in person during the meeting, or electronically using the following information:

Meeting URL: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/4358843411
Dial-In: 1-253-215-8782
Meeting ID: 435 884 3411

Written comments may also be submitted to the City Recorder, Alicia Fairbourne, at afairbourne@grantsvilleut.gov. All written comments will be distributed to the City Council and entered into the public record. To ensure consideration, written comments must be received no later than 12:00 p.m. (noon) on the day of the meeting.

A copy of the proposed budget is available for public inspection at Grantsville City Hall during regular business hours and on the Grantsville City website.

DATED this 12th day of August, 2026.

Alicia Fairbourne
Grantsville City Recorder
